uncertain_notes: TableBuffViewGlobal: buffName '罗—助阵'/'沙鳄鱼—助阵' translated as 'Law - Support'/'Crocodile - Support'; 罗 is the common short form for Trafalgar Law, 沙鳄鱼 ('Sand Crocodile') is Crocodile's nickname.

TableSeaExploreBuffGroup/TableIslandTrialsBuffGroup: 玲玲 (Big Mom's given name Linlin) translated as 'Big Mom' for recognizability rather than literally 'Linlin', since 'Big Mom' is the established English localization; noted here since the source specifically uses her given name rather than '大妈'.

TableSeaExploreBuffGroup/TableIslandTrialsBuffGroup: 黑天暗地 (a Blackbeard ultimate move name) translated literally as 'Dark Heaven, Dark Earth'; no confirmed canonical official English name identified for this specific move.

TableIslandTrialsBuffGroup: 老沙 ('Old Sand') translated literally rather than as 'Crocodile'; strongly implied to be Crocodile ('Sand Crocodile' nickname) given the Wind/Sand-elemental context, but kept as the literal nickname since the source doesn't use his actual name.
TableIslandTrialsBuffGroup: 封技 translated as 'Skill Seal' (a silence/skill-block effect); exact in-game UI term not confirmable from context alone.

TablecampBuff other_bundle_rows: all 13 rows contain the placeholder text '暂无加成' ('no bonus yet'), consistent with this being an unfinished/earlier build revision of the feature, translated literally as 'No bonus yet.' rather than inventing real bonus text.

TableUSFBuff: '纵横强化版' (ids 4000006/4000007/4000002) translated literally/transliterated as '(Zongheng Enhanced Version)'; 纵横 likely names a specific game mode or event ('conquest'/'unrivaled at sea' is the idiomatic sense) but no confirmed in-game English name was available to translate it by.

TableUSFBuff: several ship buffs use a character's name/epithet as shorthand for their associated ship (matching the pattern already seen in TableGvoShip/TableHideTreasureShipPool), e.g. '红发' ('Red-Hair') rendered as 'Shanks' for clarity (referring to his ship, Red Force), '白胡子'/'黑胡子' rendered as 'Whitebeard'/'Blackbeard'.

TableUSFBuff id 1280102 '般城丸海上防御减免10%': '防御减免' translated as 'Damage reduction increased by 10%' (an incoming-damage-reduction stat), by analogy with the parallel '海上伤害减免' phrasing used elsewhere in this table, rather than literally 'Defense reduced'.

TableUSFBuff ids 3xxxxxx (This Match / Attacking Stronghold / Defending Stronghold / On the Sea Route tiered buffs): the trailing digit (1-5) is a bare number in the source with no unit ('加攻击1' etc.), rendered as '(Tier N)' since these read as internal buff-tier labels rather than full player-facing tooltip sentences.
